Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study uses two distinct MS approaches: AP-MS to identify RBPMS interactors (comparing FL vs ΔC20) and RNA-assisted pull-down to identify proteins recruited/displaced from a specific RNA substrate (TM3) upon RBPMS addition. The factorial design in the RNA pull-down involves combinations of RNA, RBPMS, and ATP.
